summary: Mr. Harari discusses the unique minhagim and musical makamot for Parashat Shemot, Vaera, and Bo. He reviews the sources in the Pizmonim book, notes from Hakham Moshe Ashkar, and practices in Israel and Ades.
questions: What makam is used for Parashat Shemot according to the Pizmonim book and community custom?
Why do some communities use Makam Noah for Parashat Vaera?
What pizmon is sung when taking out the Sefer Torah on Shabbat Bo?
Which parasha corresponds to Makam Siga in the Pizmonim book?
